user_statement: 考虑到舵机的大小，交界处的宽度不能变。
scope: All original servo mounts and inter-part joint interfaces, not only screw-hole centers
must_preserve: Servo pocket/seat internal width and depth
Separation of paired supporting plates around each servo
Local connector/tab/slot widths and engagement dimensions
Screw bearing thickness and original fastener grip stack
Joint axis locations within each local assembly and existing alignment
Servo horn, bearing/axle seat and original mechanical clearances
allowed_change: Superseded 30 mm center extension: new confirmed target is 50 mm total edge extension, moving leg-root groups 25 mm each while central PCB mounts/opening stay fixed. Mapping PCB support interface to CAD is required before rebuild.

current_evidence.upper_frame: validation/first_draft_checks.json confirms each original half is unchanged after rigid translation
current_evidence.shin_plate: Protected connector regions and original 3 mm core match the reconstructed reference. Added exterior relief reaches 4.2 mm total only outside checked interface islands.
current_evidence.limitations: This is not verification against a measured servo envelope or full assembled leg sweep.

release_gates: Compare original vs redesigned local interface sections and plate separation
Place original servo/shaft envelope in correct assembly coordinates
Check full joint travel, cable path and screw access
Physical fit test before complete printing
latest_user_update: 2026-10-31 white-blue palette; PCB fixed; outer legs translated
